description: Daniel returns to human form as SG-1 focuses on finding Ancient knowledge capable of stopping Anubis. The rise of the Kull warriors and growing pressure on Earth culminate in Anubis’s direct assault and SG-1’s desperate search for the Lost City.

s07e01.description: SG-1 finds Daniel alive but without his memories, while Jonas is drawn back into Kelowna’s conflict and Anubis searches for a powerful Ancient city.

s07e02.description: Anubis occupies Kelowna and forces SG-1, Jonas and Daniel into a risky attempt to retake the planet and recover the Eye of Ra.

s07e03.description: A teenage version of O’Neill appears at Stargate Command, leading SG-1 to uncover an Asgard experiment involving Jack’s genetics.

s07e04.description: Teal’c and Bra’tac are captured by Jaffa loyalists, forcing Daniel to help Teal’c overcome guilt and regain the will to fight.

s07e05.description: SG-1 enters a sealed community protected by an artificial intelligence that quietly rewrites everyone’s memories to preserve its shrinking population.

s07e06.description: A wrecked alien vessel transfers multiple personalities into Daniel, leaving the SGC to separate desperate survivors sharing one body.

s07e07.description: A mining dispute on an Unas world threatens to become violent until Daniel reunites with Chaka and tries negotiation instead of force.

s07e08.description: Carter enters an interstellar race aboard an alien ship, where sabotage turns a sporting event into a test of survival and diplomacy.

s07e09.description: A scientist’s attempt to disable enemy Stargates infects the entire gate network, leaving him and Carter racing to reverse the damage.

s07e10.description: SG-1 meets a hidden community of female Jaffa seeking freedom from Goa’uld control and a safer way to survive without symbiotes.

s07e11.description: Anubis deploys an almost unstoppable genetically engineered warrior, while Daniel searches Central America for evidence of Ancient technology.

s07e12.description: Daniel is kidnapped in Honduras as Carter and Jacob study Anubis’s new warrior, uncovering the source of its remarkable defenses.

s07e13.description: Carter is stranded aboard a damaged Prometheus and begins seeing people from her past while trying to survive alone.

s07e14.description: Jonas returns with evidence that a naquadria reaction could destroy his planet, forcing SG-1 to help resolve a crisis rooted deep underground.

s07e15.description: Carter’s new relationship collides with her hidden life at the SGC while Osiris uses Daniel’s dreams to search for Ancient knowledge.

s07e16.description: Anubis attacks the Alpha Site and a new anti-Goa’uld drug is tested under fire, leaving Carter and Jacob in a desperate fight to survive.

s07e17.description: A documentary crew arrives at Stargate Command to record the people behind the program just as SG-13 encounters trouble off-world.

s07e18.description: After a devastating mission, the SGC struggles with loss while officials decide what the public can ever be told about those who serve there.

s07e19.description: An NID laboratory produces a dangerous genetically engineered woman, and SG-1 investigates the covert program that created her.

s07e20.description: A newly elected president is briefed on the Stargate program while Kinsey and the NID maneuver to reshape control of the SGC.

s07e21-22.description: Anubis prepares a massive assault on Earth as SG-1 follows Ancient clues to the Lost City, gambling everything on knowledge hidden inside O’Neill’s mind.
